changes.comment: sdk-code-convertors: the generated Python models no longer truncate schema unions. A union member that carried only the `type` discriminator validated any payload with a matching type and dropped every other key on model_dump(); QueryFilter, QuerySort, Metadata, Fields, DashboardFilters, DashboardFiltersNoGroups and Interaction now resolve to the real per-type models in both pydantic_models.py and _types.py.
